recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a woman with voluminous blonde curls, wearing a leopard-print garment against a solid black background. The lighting is warm and golden, creating a monochromatic yellow-gold tint across the subject, while the typography is positioned at the top in a classic serif style.
coreVisualRelationships: Golden subject against deep black negative space
Text alignment centered at the top header
Texture contrast between soft hair and sharp leopard pattern
Warm yellow highlights vs cool black shadows
coreInvariants: Golden-yellow color cast on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, highlighted by the golden glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, moves down to the face, then follows the texture of the hair and leopard print to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject and behind the header text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden Yellow (Subject highlights and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low color variety; the image relies on value shifts within a monochromatic yellow-gold spectrum.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to a black and gold/yellow palette

characterSpecificRedesigns: Increased letter-spacing for a luxury feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and minimalist luxury.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif structure with high legibility and traditional elegance.
Higher contrast for a more fashion-forward, editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with long curly blonde hair, wearing a leopard-print shirt, lit with warm golden light against a solid black background. The top 20% of the image should be empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered all-caps serif text in the top black area using a pale gold color with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and all-caps?
Is the leopard print clearly visible?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the leopard print pattern
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Specific font choice (use generic serif equivalents)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the golden glow does not wash out facial details.
Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the leopard print looks like fabric, not a flat overlay.
Confirm the black background is deep and uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait with [Subject Description] + [Patterned Clothing] + [Golden Lighting] + [Black Background] + [Top-Aligned Serif Header]
